commands.name: junkd
commands.description: Toggle the junkd pane: the marketplace plugins, their settings and commands

children: the main settings of core, handoff, orch, tldr
slash commands of the enabled plugins
checked every 5 tool calls · next check in 5
the guard and the rule sheet; off: neither
hold the main loop to planning and delegating
an explicit Fable model on a subagent
reuse an implementer under this many k tokens · 50–1000
ui-reviewer on web UI criteria; off: PM-REVIEW rows
ORCHESTRATOR.md into the main session at start
the CLAUDE.md orchestrator section as a pointer block; off removes it
enter in a field saves it · also in /config, under junkd (orch_…)

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
